warnings: All truss members are printed 'โครงถักทั้งหมด C-100x50x20x2.3mm' (lipped channel d100 x b50 x lip20 x t2.3, spec 6a key order as house 165). Purlins C-75x37x8.5x0.75mm (prefabricated galvanised).
The truss panel chains (1.31 x 8; 1.13/1.13/1.13/0.93/0.93) and the top plan strip 2.20 / 10.50 / 2.20 are element-internal truss geometry and are kept here, not swept into the grid master.

Purlin width printed 37 here ('C-75x37x8.5x0.75mm') but 35 on S-19 note 5 ('C-75x35x8.5x0.75mm@ 1.00m.') and on A-05's handwriting; kept as printed on this sheet, the conflict is recorded in the S-19 notes file.
